test_title: PYST 1: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence ((Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people L, M, N, O, P,Q and R are sitting in a straight line adjacent to one another, facing the north (not necessarily in the given order).

P is sitting third to the left of Q. N is an immediate neighbour of O and Q. L is sitting third to the right of Q. R is the immediate neighbour of L and M.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of P?
solution:
As per the given information:

1. P is sitting third to the left of Q.

P, _, _, Q

2. L is sitting third to the right of Q and R is the immediate neighbour of L and M.

P, _, _, Q, M, R, L

3. N is an immediate neighbour of O and Q.

P, **O**, N, Q, M, R, L

Here,** O** is sitting to the immediate right of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
